title: Currentness epistemic classification record
description: Schema for the record emitted by measure.py. Created under ADMISSIBILITY-CONSEQUENCE BOUNDED IMPLEMENTATION WARRANT 001. Before this file the OUTPUT record had no schema at all: the two existing schemas describe the INPUT event dataset. The warrant permits omission only where a schema declares the field conditional, so the schema had to exist for the permission to be usable.

admissibility_consequence.description: CONDITIONAL. Present only when a separately identified institutional authority has bound this epistemic classification to a reliance consequence. This layer never emits it. Its ABSENCE is readable precisely because this schema declares it conditional; absence therefore does not mean loss in transit. null is FORBIDDEN: a field present with null is still carried by the record and is ambiguous four ways — not computed, not applicable, false, absent.

admissibility_determination.description: REQUIRED. The typed state of the admissibility question itself, carried OUTSIDE the target-plane result. It is not a consequence and must never be read as one.
